Hospital Course & Recovery Trajectory

Patient presented with high-grade pyrexia, severe arthralgia, and rapid platelet decrease. Managed aggressively with targeted IV crystalloid hydration protocol, anti-pyretics, and vitals monitoring every 4 hours. No hemorrhagic manifestations observed. Platelet count stabilized on Day 3 and rebounded to 1.45 Lakhs/mcL on Day 4. Patient is afebrile for >48 hours, tolerating full oral diet, and hemodynamically stable.
